description:
## Background

React Doctor identifies four related problems along the Workspace-selection path: `SelectorBody` exposes four boolean flags, `WorkspaceSelector.tsx` exports two non-component helpers, and `useWorkspaceCoordinator` recreates an empty `Set` on every render before React discards it. Together these findings indicate a shallow presentation interface and misplaced implementation details rather than four independent product defects.

The Workspace selector already derives a coherent view from Current Workspace, Pending Workspace, catalog error, cancellation, and retry facts. That derived state should cross one explicit seam instead of being flattened into boolean combinations.

## What to build

Make Workspace selection easier to reason about without changing its behavior: represent selector presentation as an explicit variant, keep React component files component-only, and initialize the active Workspace-program registry exactly once.

## Technical Approach

- Replace `SelectorBody`'s `canCancel`, `showLoadingLabel`, `showStorageFailure`, and `showSwitchBanner` interface with a discriminated presentation model or named variants.
- Preserve the existing mutually exclusive storage-recovery and normal-Workspace presentations.
- Move `pickerDefaultPath` to a focused non-React Workspace module used by `useWorkspaceCoordinator` and its tests.
- Make `workspaceBasename` private to the component module unless the new presentation module genuinely owns it.
- Lazily and predictably initialize `activeProgramsRef` so a new `Set` is not allocated on every render.
- Keep the public `WorkspaceSelector` interface stable unless a smaller interface demonstrably improves its callers.

## Considerations

- Preserve `data-pending-path`, `data-testid="cancel-workspace-switch"`, and `data-testid="switch-failure-banner"` because tests and E2E helpers depend on them.
- Preserve cancellation availability, retry eligibility, catalog-storage recovery, dismissed switch failures, and unavailable Workspace presentation.
- `bsm-xii.3` composes `useWorkspaceCoordinator` behind a larger coordinator. This issue has no hard blocker, but its branch should be rebased before landing if both changes touch the hook.
- Do not add a pass-through private hook merely to reduce file length; the presentation variant should deepen the existing seam.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Selector rendering is selected through an explicit presentation variant rather than four independent boolean props.
- [ ] `WorkspaceSelector.tsx` exports React components only.
- [ ] Native picker default-path behavior remains unchanged from Current Workspace through catalog fallback.
- [ ] The active Workspace-program registry is initialized once and retains its interruption/cleanup behavior.
- [ ] Pending, cancellation, recovery, retry, removal, and switch-failure user paths behave as before.
- [ ] The four targeted React Doctor warnings are absent without disabling their rules.

## Test Plan

- Extend or preserve `src/components/WorkspaceSelector.test.tsx` coverage for each presentation variant and picker default.
- Run focused Workspace coordinator lifecycle tests covering supersession and interruption.
- Run `mise run ts:test`, `mise run doctor:react`, and `mise run verify`.
- No new desktop E2E scenario is required; use existing Workspace-selection scenarios as regression evidence if the refactor changes observable markup.

## Triage

ready-for-agent
title: Deepen the Workspace selection modules
